name: ai-report-writer
description: Write clear, well-structured bug bounty vulnerability reports that triagers can reproduce on the first try.

interface.longDescription: Turn a validated finding into a concise bug bounty report: structured title, short description, reproducible steps, evidence-based impact and honest severity. Also reviews existing drafts against Intigriti's report-writing guidance.
defaultPrompt: Write up this IDOR finding as a bug bounty report.
Review my vulnerability report draft before I submit it.
